Grandmother (奶奶) says, "I am (我是) lost."
She looks at an (一个) old (老的) map (地图).
Then she picks up a fan (风扇) in her hand (手).
She blows the wind back (向后).
Now she can (能) see the road!
She is at (在…) home (家) now.
